lines.text: Aa... aa... aa... mere humsafar
Tere khayalon me kho gaya hai mera ye jahan
Pehli nazar me hi ban gayi tu meri dastaan
Dheere se chhua jo hawa ne laga tu paas hai
Tere bina ye dil mera kitna udaas hai
Tu hi meri subah hai tu hi meri shaam
Har ek dhadkan likh rahi bas tera hi naam
Saansein judi hain meri tere hi aashiyane se
Pyaar ho gaya mujhe tere hi muskurane se
Khushboo teri aati hai jab bhi chale ye thandi pawan
Tujhe sochkar hi jhoom uthta hai mera ye man
Chaha tha jisko khwabon me wo manzil mil gayi
Kore kaagaz si zindagi me nayi rangat khil gayi
Tu hi meri subah hai tu hi meri shaam
Har ek dhadkan likh rahi bas tera hi naam
Saansein judi hain meri tere hi aashiyane se
Pyaar ho gaya mujhe tere hi muskurane se
Taaron se chura ke laoon tere liye ye roshni
Suron me saja ke gaaoon teri hi aashiqui
Kadam se kadam milakar chalte chalein hum sada
Duniya roothe chahe hum na honge juda
Tu hi meri subah hai tu hi meri shaam
Har ek dhadkan likh rahi bas tera hi naam
Saansein judi hain meri tere hi aashiyane se
Pyaar ho gaya mujhe tere hi muskurane se
Rab se maangi thi jo dua wo asar ho gaya
Mera har lamha tere hi naam par ho gaya
Haath thaam ke chalna mere humsafar
Suhana lagega ab zindagi ka har safar
Tu hi meri subah hai tu hi meri shaam
Har ek dhadkan likh rahi bas tera hi naam
Saansein judi hain meri tere hi aashiyane se
Pyaar ho gaya mujhe tere hi muskurane se
Tu hai toh hai jannat tu hai toh sab sahi
Meri har khushi bas tujhme hi basi
Tere sang beetein saare janam yahi
Humsafar mere tu hi meri zindagi
Har saans me tera hi aks nazar aaye
Dua hai rab se ye rishta kabhi na toot paaye
Humsafar mere... tu hi meri zindagi...
Aa... aa... aa... tere bina adhoori har khushi...
